- Grounded in retention and lifetime value economics, cohort analysis and CRM driven measurement, not only acquisition

- Travel Insurance

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. 

 

About the Role

The Data Applications team builds the data platform that Riskified’s development teams build on. Our goal is to make it self-service: teams get databases, access and data pipelines on Aerospike, CockroachDB, Elasticsearch, Neo4j and PostgreSQL without waiting on us.
We also run the data infrastructure behind Riskified’s AI-driven fraud detection. Our pipelines and low-latency stores feed the models that decide on every order in real time, and connect them to the data lake.
As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you will own large parts of this platform, from self-service tooling and data pipelines to production clusters of 100+ nodes. You will also be a go-to database expert for R&D.

What You'll Be Doing

• Build self-service tooling and infrastructure as code so development teams can create and manage databases, access and pipelines on their own.

• Build the data infrastructure behind our AI fraud models: pipelines that move data between the data lake and low-latency operational stores, in batch and through change data capture (CDC).

• Design and build new data services, such as low-latency access to data stored on S3.

• Act as the database expert for R&D: review data models and access patterns, and help teams choose the right data store.

• Use AI coding agents in daily work and build automation around them for the team.

• Own large-scale production database clusters (key-value, distributed SQL, search and graph), including performance, cost, and major upgrades and migrations with zero downtime.

• Share an on-call rotation and lead incident investigations across the database, infrastructure and application layers.

Qualifications

• Experienced data platform, database reliability or big data infrastructure engineer, with a B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

• Deep hands-on experience running at least two distributed data stores in production at high scale, such as Aerospike, CockroachDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Neo4j, PostgreSQL, Cassandra or Redis.

• Strong grasp of distributed-systems fundamentals: replication, partitioning, consistency models and failure modes.

• Strong coding skills in Python.

• Production experience with Terraform and AWS, including on-call ownership of production incidents.

• Clear communication in English, and a track record of guiding other engineers and teams.

Big plus for this role:

• Lakehouse tools: Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg and Airflow.

• Kafka and CDC: CockroachDB changefeeds, Debezium or AWS DMS.

• Aerospike operations: strong consistency, cross-datacenter replication (XDR) and capacity planning.

• Coding in Scala, Java, Go or Node.js/TypeScript, such as client libraries or Terraform providers.

• Kubernetes, and debugging performance at the Linux level (CPU, memory, disk I/O, network).

• Hands-on use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code for infrastructure work.

About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

At Black Semiconductor, we are looking for a Senior Metrology Engineer (f/m/d) to support the development and optimization of our semiconductor manufacturing processes

In this role, you will take ownership of metrology methods and measurement systems, developing and optimizing recipes for ellipsometry, reflectometry, scatterometry, and other metrology techniques. Working closely with process engineers, equipment vendors, and maintenance teams, you will ensure accurate and reliable measurements of critical process parameters while driving improvements in measurement capabilities, equipment performance, and process control

To join our team, you should be excited to

· Serve as the process owner for semiconductor metrology, developing, sustaining, and optimizing measurement methods for production and process development

· Develop and optimize measurement recipes for ellipsometry, reflectometry, scatterometry, and other metrology systems

· Develop measurement methods for film thickness, refractive index (RI), feature dimensions, wafer bow, and other critical process parameters

· Establish appropriate measurement locations, sampling plans, and measurement strategies to ensure accurate and representative process data

· Apply SPC, DOE, and statistical analysis to monitor and improve measurement and manufacturing processes

· Work with equipment vendors and maintenance personnel to improve measurement performance, reliability, and uptime

· Associate degree in Metrology, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 5+ years of experience in metrology with precision equipment related to ellipsometry and scatterometry; experience in semiconductor, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing environments is ideal

· Hands-on experience with ellipsometry and/or scatterometry techniques

· Experience with MSA, Gage R&R, tool matching, measurement correlation, and measurement system capability

· Strong background in SPC, DOE, process capability, statistical analysis, and root cause analysis

· Proficiency with ellipsometry/scatterometry and additional metrology systems, as well as JMP, Excel, and other data analysis tools; experience creating and maintaining measurement recipes/jobs and providing training to peers and process engineers

· Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with high attention to detail and the ability to work under tight deadlines

· Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

· Ability to work on-site in a semiconductor manufacturing and cleanroom environment

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key-we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around

About the Client
A behavioral health consultancy that manages contracting, credentialing, and billing for US Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) providers is looking for a Contracting and Credentialing Specialist to own provider enrollments from first submission through payer approval.
The company has grown on the back of a 99% client satisfaction rate and now has a waitlist for new enrollments. The credentialing team includes a manager, a specialist counterpart, and two assistants. Many of its clients are outsourcing credentialing for the first time.
About the Role
This individual contributor role is 90% contracting and credentialing and 10% billing support. Day to day, the specialist submits provider enrollment applications, follows up with Medicaid and other payers, tracks deadlines across multiple client accounts, and answers client questions within a 24-hour SLA. Submissions take top priority because they start enrollment timelines that run from 30 days to 9 months. Success means on-time submissions, no stalled provider files, and clients who get status updates before they ask.
Core Responsibilities
Contracting and Credentialing Operations

• Submit provider enrollment applications to Medicaid and other insurance payers, prioritizing new submissions to start enrollment timelines.

• Follow up with payers on pending applications and credentialing status through to approval.

• Research payer-specific enrollment requirements for new and existing payers.

• Track enrollment deadlines, application statuses, and provider files across multiple client accounts.

• Meet monthly enrollment reporting deadlines.

Client Communication and Support

• Act as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts on credentialing matters.

• Respond to client inquiries within a 24-hour SLA.

• Send enrollment updates based on each client's stage in the process.

• Resolve open issues by phone when email threads need a real-time answer.

• Walk new clients through the contracting and credentialing process, especially those outsourcing for the first time.

Billing Support

• Complete provider enrollments in billing software so claims can be submitted.

• Troubleshoot claim denials caused by credentialing issues.

• Answer billing-related client questions during credentialing and route primary billing inquiries to the billing team.

Requirements

• 1+ years of hands-on contracting and credentialing experience (2+ years preferred), owning a caseload of provider enrollments across multiple payers

• Credentialing experience on both the payer side (submitting applications and following up with insurance payers) and the provider side (enrolling providers in billing systems)

• Medicaid enrollment experience, including application submission and payer follow-up

• Experience managing concurrent provider files and deadlines across multiple client accounts using a tracking system

• Client-facing credentialing experience as a primary point of contact by email and phone, working to response SLAs

• C1+ English (CEFR) for written and phone communication with US-based clients

Nice-to-Have

• ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis) or behavioral health credentialing experience

• Credentialing experience across other medical specialties, such as mental health, pediatrics, or therapy services

• Experience at an outsourced credentialing, medical billing, or revenue cycle management (RCM) firm serving multiple provider clients

• Enrollment experience with other government payers, such as Medicare or Tricare
